name: portfolio
description: One server for the portfolio site (/), admin (/admin) and API (/api)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix admin install && npm --prefix front install
scripts.build: npm --prefix front run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.setup:static: npm --prefix front ci && npm --prefix admin ci
scripts.build:static: npm --prefix front run build && npm --prefix admin run build:static
